identification: Set of 6 high-back cane-panelled dining chairs (description: SET OF 6 CANE BACKED UPHOLSTERED DINING CHAIRS). Shaped serpentine back frames with carved scroll crest rails, woven cane back panels, stained oak/fruitwood-look frames, dusty pink velvet-type drop-in upholstered seats, turned and ringed front legs. Photo 1 shows all six (4 side chairs, 2 carvers with arms), photo 2 a carver close up, photo 3 a side chair. Late 20th century American/Asian-made colonial style (not antique). Some cane damage visible: a patch on the back of the chair in photo 3 and wear on seats.

entries.note: Auction, 1 bid. 'Set of 6 Vint. Antique Original Wooden & Cane Dining Chairs', title partly cut off; described as original antique, so likely a better set than these late 20th century chairs.
Single vintage carved cane back armchair, French Provincial style upholstered.
